_written_by: lane F2, 2026-09-30 (worker, unattended). Values are SERVED DEFAULTS except where marked PROPOSED. The PM rules on every PROPOSED line; nothing here adopts anything.

seal_lift_approved.meaning: true lets the ratings chain (and the live inputs' prior-season tables) read the sealed 2025-26 season (CBB_UNSEAL=1 is then set only inside the chain's unsealed() context). No served default exists: until true the ratings, inputs and sim stages stay BLOCKED on this flag.
seal_lift_approved.evidence: docs/ops/own_ratings_daily_2026-09-30.md section 4 item 1; PROJECT_STATUS.md re-plan table (unseal 2025-26 Oct 10-17); docs/ops/worker_rules_overnight_2026-09-30.md (2025-26 stays SEALED overnight)

teams_source.meaning: team set used for re-centring. The code default is tg (teams that have played), impossible on day 1 (no games); schedule (hoopR) gives only 319 D-I teams because the hoopR 2027 schedule is thin; cbbd (CBBD games + team_crosswalk_v2) gives 365.
teams_source.evidence: docs/ops/own_ratings_daily_2026-09-30.md section 4 item 3 and modelling choice 6; docs/ops/readiness_2026-27_2026-09-30.md section 2 (gap 5); for 2025 schedule and game-based sets give 364 teams and identical ratings (parity json)

prior_weight_policy.meaning: manifest_uniform = w 0.8 (eff and tempo) uniform carry of last season's final fit (build_own_ratings_asof_v1.py). arm_C_conference = cm + 0.6419 (c_prev - cm), carry toward the team's current-conference mean (build_own_ratings_asof_C_v1.py); selected offline, PENDING as a retrain-set dimension, NOT adopted. Switching is a one-word edit; the chain then writes to ratings_asof_C/.
prior_weight_policy.evidence: docs/models/own_ratings/experiments.md sections 1-3 (winner C on fold-2 pooled MAE, interval excludes F and K); docs/ops/own_ratings_C_asof_parity_2026-09-30.json (entry point parity)

new_team_prior.meaning: a team with no previous rating (West Florida) gets 0 = league mean by rule; a conference-level prior is a candidate, not implemented.

fixed_term_prior.meaning: intercept, home, away and neutral-tempo priors are last season's final values (league scoring level and pace carry through).
fixed_term_prior.evidence: docs/ops/own_ratings_daily_2026-09-30.md section 4 modelling choice 4; docs/models/own_ratings/experiments.md (held at R, 1.8)

early_season_d1_rule.meaning: is_d1_game = at least 5 conference games UNION prior-season D-I teams (the daily ingestion's provisional rule); exhibitions vs non-D-I never enter a fit.
